summary: T1 item 1 (design sources): signoff/design-sources-inventory.md lists the committed xschem sources of the rcosc_top hierarchy (rcosc_top, rcosc_bias, rcosc_comparator, rcosc_comparator_p, rcosc_trim_bank: .sch + .sym each, plus design/xschemrc), the derived netlist design/netlist/rcosc_top.spice, and its regeneration command design/regen-netlist.sh. 'pass' asserts the inventory was audited against the tree (every listed path committed; the committed netlist re-derived from the schematics into a scratch directory and found identical after normalising line wrapping and path comments). It is NOT a claim that the design meets the ratified spec (see item 8 and issue #66).
